name: ExpertClor_v01
summary: ExpertClor_v01 is a momentum-based EA that likely uses color-based indicator signals (such as moving average color changes or candle color patterns) to generate trade entries and exits. It operates systematically, opening positions when momentum shifts are detected through color transitions of technical indicators. The EA appears to be an early version (v01) suggesting it may be a foundational implementation with room for refinement.
summary_zh: ExpertClor_v01是一个基于动量的EA，可能使用基于颜色的指标信号（如移动平均线颜色变化或K线颜色模式）来生成交易入场和出场信号。它以系统化方式运作，当通过技术指标的颜色转换检测到动量转移时开仓。该EA为早期版本(v01)，表明可能是基础实现，仍有优化空间。
strategy_analysis: ExpertClor_v01的策略概念基于颜色信号驱动的动量交易，通过技术指标的颜色变化来捕捉趋势动量的转换。入场条件可能依赖于指标颜色从一种状态转变为另一种状态（例如均线由红转绿表示上升动量建立），在颜色切换确认时开仓。出场条件可能采用反向颜色信号作为平仓触发，或结合固定止盈止损来管理持仓。仓位管理方面，从文件名v01版本来看，可能采用固定手数或简单的资金管理规则，缺乏高级的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，作为早期版本，可能缺少完善的风险控制逻辑，如最大持仓限制、回撤保护等。整体策略逻辑依赖于指标颜色信号的及时性和准确性，存在滞后性风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of ExpertClor_v01 is based on color-signal-driven momentum trading, capturing shifts in trend momentum through color changes of technical indicators. Entry conditions likely depend on indicator color transitions from one state to another (e.g., moving average turning from red to green signaling upward momentum building), opening positions upon color switch confirmation. Exit conditions may use reverse color signals as position-closing triggers, or combine fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels for position management. Regarding position sizing, as an early v01 version, it likely employs fixed lot sizes or simple money management rules, lacking advanced dynamic position adjustment mechanisms. For money management, as an early version, it may lack comprehensive risk control logic such as maximum position limits, drawdown protection, or equity-based safeguards. The overall strategy logic depends on the timeliness and accuracy of indicator color signals, carrying inherent lag risk inherent to indicator-based systems.

pros: 基于颜色信号的策略逻辑直观易懂，便于理解和调试
系统化交易方式减少了情绪干扰，执行纪律性强
采用技术指标信号入场，具有一定的趋势捕捉能力
pros_en: Color-signal-based strategy logic is intuitive and easy to understand, facilitating debugging and maintenance
Systematic trading approach reduces emotional interference and ensures disciplined execution
Uses technical indicator signals for entry, providing some trend-capturing capability
cons: 依赖指标颜色信号存在固有滞后性，入场可能延迟
作为v01早期版本，可能缺乏完善的风险管理和仓位控制机制
颜色信号在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号，导致连续亏损
cons_en: Reliance on indicator color signals carries inherent lag, potentially causing delayed entries
As an early v01 version, it likely lacks comprehensive risk management and position control mechanisms
Color signals tend to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
improvements: 增加多时间周期确认机制，减少虚假信号
加入动态仓位管理和资金管理模块，根据账户净值调整风险敞口
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism to reduce false signals
Implement dynamic position sizing and money management module to adjust risk exposure based on account equity

risk_points: 颜色信号在震荡市中可能频繁触发虚假交易，导致手续费损耗和连续止损
缺乏高级资金管理机制，在不利行情下可能承受较大回撤
risk_points_en: Color signals may frequently trigger false trades in ranging markets, causing commission drain and consecutive stop-losses
Lacks advanced money management mechanisms, potentially suffering significant drawdowns during adverse market conditions
